Trajectory: @merge fix landed mid-run; agent then burned ~40% of the 3060s budget editing its own test assertions (tests/test_base.py [64][72]) and chasing test_get_item KeyError 'DOTENV_INT' - a fixture-ordering artifact that fails isolated file runs [61][77] but passes in the full suite [78] (375/375 green). Instead of submitting at all-green, the agent went back to investigate the ghost ([79][80] grep test_get_item) and was SIGKILLed mid-command at elapsed 3077s. Root cause: no baseline-vs-current failure classification - a check failure unrelated to the diff reads identically to a regression the agent introduced. FIXED (provider-free): SuiteVerdictLedger joins baseline name sets with the agent's own suite-scope observations; classify_failures_vs_baseline emits unverified_scope/scope_artifact/baseline_noise/regression_new/suite_failing/untracked per failing name into execution_evidence rows (layout_schema gt.baseline_classification.v1) and the GT_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE model line. Conservative direction held: a scoped run never writes a suite FAILURE (that asymmetry is the incident) though a green one promotes inside its own coverage; zero-failure promotion requires an affirmative aggregate - a positive pass count AND the runner's own terminal summary line (pytest '<n> passed ... in <t>s', or unittest 'Ran <n> tests' followed by OK/FAILED) - because a single parsed PASSED row from a '| tail -20' of a verbose run otherwise promoted the entire baseline and opened the submit window; a missing baseline no longer disables the classifier but runs it on a suite_observed basis. Quantified postmortem: 0 plan_gate_decision rows (the agent never once requested submit); last green full-suite run at +2880s of a 3061s budget; baseline capture status no_test_verdicts (pytest collection interrupted, 4 errors, 0 names) so plan_inputs.baseline.captured was False; 10/10 test commands compound ('cd /testbed && python -m pytest ... 2>&1 | tail -N'), which the scope parser read as unknown for all ten, so the classifier ran zero times in 3061s. Covering node ids include test_truncated_verbose_tail_does_not_promote_or_open_window, test_action_45_promotes_under_coverage_but_not_ignored_files, test_scoped_failure_never_becomes_suite_truth and test_pristine_probe_makes_later_failures_read_baseline_noise.
